_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Ungu-Player {player_id} emdlalweni we-LinesOfAction.
Mapisi akho ngawo '{side}', mapisi ampangeli ngawo '{other}'.
Format ye-move: `[b1b3]` (ikoordineeti ye-from ne-ye-to). Umendo osemthethweni uhamba ngokwesobunxele, ngokwesokudla, noma ngokwesokunene isikweletu esilingana ne-mapisi onke (nganoma iyiphi inombolo) kulo mstari. Ungagibela phezu kwemapisi akho, kodwa ungagibeli phezu kwemapisi ampangeli; ukugibela phezu kwempisi ampangeli kuyiyoza.  Uphumelele lapho mapisi akho onke ayekwelekele.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifomethi kumele ibe ngu e2e4 (kusuka,kuya ku-coordinates).
invalid_move.identical: Umtfombo kanye nendzawo lokuyiwa kuyo kuyafana.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Kuhamba kumele kube ngco nobe ngekuphambana.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Kumele ihambe ngebudze lobulingana netincenye letihambisanako.
